questions.stem: A ball is launched horizontally at $12\ \mathrm{m/s}$ from a cliff $45\ \mathrm{m}$ above the ground. Air resistance is negligible. How far from the base of the cliff does it land?
questions.solution: The vertical fall sets the time: $t = \sqrt{\dfrac{2h}{g}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2(45)}{10}} = 3\ \mathrm{s}$. The horizontal distance is then $x = v_{x}t = (12)(3) = 36\ \mathrm{m}$.
